title: Court Records Should Be Free
summary: An EFF advocacy article arguing that court records should be freely accessible to the public, contending that current fee-based systems for accessing public court documents undermine judicial transparency and civic participation.
problem_solved: Addresses the barrier of paid access to public court records that limits transparency and public participation in the judicial system.
why_valuable: Promotes equal access to justice and government transparency by arguing that public court records should not be monetized.
